select * from ( SELECT bda.bookset_id as booksetId, deal.trade_id as tradeId, deal.finprod_id as finprodId, deal.finprod_type as finprodType, prd.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr, bda.busi_table as busiTable, deal.inv_aim as orgDealInvaim, bdone.inv_aim as assetInvaim, bdtwo.inv_aim as secDetailTypeInvaim, bdThree.inv_aim as specialInvaim, ifnull(bdThree.inv_aim,ifnull(bdtwo.inv_aim,bdone.inv_aim)) as changeInvaim
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT prd on prd.finprod_id = deal.finprod_id and prd.finprod_type = deal.finprod_type INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE pty ON pty.finprod_id = prd.finprod_id INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING bda ON bda.busi_no = deal.trade_id INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN bbp ON bbp.bookset_id = bda.bookset_id LEFT JOIN (
SELECT a.scheme_detail_id, a.scheme_id, a.Sec_Detail_Type, a.inv_aim, a.vdate, a.rn FROM ( SELECT tmp.*, @rownum := @rownum + 1 rownum, /* 虚拟列行标 */ IF( ( @scheme_id = tmp.scheme_id ), @rank := @rank + 1, @rank := 1) AS rn, /* 分组虚拟列行标 */ @scheme_id := tmp.scheme_id /* 分组条件1 */ FROM ( /* 数据源 */ SELECT * FROM BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL ORDER BY vdate DESC ) tmp, /* 定义临时变量池 */ (SELECT @rownum := 0, @scheme_id := null, @rank := 0) a ) a WHERE a.sec_type= '01' AND a.Sec_Detail_Type is null AND #{booksetDate,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.vdate )bdone on bdone.scheme_id = bbp.scheme_id and bdone.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN (
SELECT a.scheme_detail_id, a.scheme_id, a.Sec_Detail_Type, a.inv_aim, a.vdate, a.rn FROM ( SELECT tmp.*, @rownum := @rownum + 1 rownum, /* 虚拟列行标 */ IF( ( @scheme_id = tmp.scheme_id and @sec_detail_type = tmp.sec_detail_type ), @rank := @rank + 1, @rank := 1) AS rn, /* 分组虚拟列行标 */ @scheme_id := tmp.scheme_id /* 分组条件1 */ , @sec_detail_type := tmp.sec_detail_type /* 分组条件1 */ FROM ( /* 数据源 */ SELECT * FROM BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL ORDER BY vdate DESC ) tmp, /* 定义临时变量池 */ (SELECT @rownum := 0, @scheme_id := null, @sec_detail_type := null, @rank := 0) a ) a WHERE a.sec_type= '01' AND #{booksetDate,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.vdate )bdtwo ON bdtwo.scheme_id = bbp.scheme_id AND bdtwo.sec_detail_type = pty.type_1 and bdtwo.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL_SPECIAL bdThree ON bdThree.Scheme_Id = bbp.scheme_id AND bdThree.Finprod_Id = deal.finprod_id AND deal.trade_date >= bdThree.vdate AND ifnull(bdThree.mdate,STR_TO_DATE('2099-12-31','%Y-%m-%d')) >= deal.trade_date
WHERE 1=1 AND deal.finprod_type = 'F01' AND bda.bookset_id = #{bookset,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND deal.trade_date = #{booksetDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) a where a.orgDealInvaim! = a.changeInvAim and a.changeInvAim is not null

SELECT b.inv_aim FROM ( SELECT a.* FROM BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL a WHERE a.sec_type = '01' AND a.Sec_Detail_Type is null AND a.scheme_id = #{schemeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.vdate order by a.vdate desc ) b WHERE LIMIT=1

SELECT b.inv_aim FROM ( SELECT a.* FROM BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL a WHERE a.sec_type = '01' AND a.scheme_id = #{schemeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.sec_detail_type = #{secDetailType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.vdate order by a.vdate desc ) b WHERE LIMIT=1
